notes.title: Hero Planter Demo released!
notes.content:
Welcome to Hero Planter, a thrilling rogue-lite game that combines planting and battling like never before! In this demo version, get a taste of the exciting adventures that await you and embark on an epic journey to become the ultimate hero planter.

Step into the shoes of a brave adventurer who has been entrusted with the responsibility of rejuvenating a underground land. Strategically plan your garden layout and choose the perfect plants to grow.

The demo version of Hero Planter offers a captivating gameplay experience with a limited number of levels and challenges. Test your strategic skills and witness the potential of your gardening prowess in this first taste of the adventure that awaits. Unlock hidden secrets and uncover unique plant species that will only be available in the full version of the game.

Are you ready to become the legendary Hero Planter? Don't miss out on this opportunity to try the demo version and be amazed by the innovative blend of gardening and monster battles. Get ready to embark on an extraordinary quest like no other!
